correctness.rationale: Block reduction fixes one maximal-rank square-zero operator; anticommutation gives the induced map on ker A/im A; maximal rank is equivalent to invertibility of this map. Surjective endomorphism restriction, a complete count of rank-r square-zero A, and maximal-square-zero class normalization give every exact factor. Euler-product estimates yield summable bias and O_q(1/m) total-variation discrepancy. Direct exhaustive prime-field computations match all nine cases.

value.rationale: For a natural pair of maximally nilpotent index-two operators, the joint condition of commutativity is rare while the rank of their product has a non-obvious, exactly computable distribution. The uniform law of large numbers on an expanding range contrasts structurally with rank concentration of commuting idempotent pairs; infinite-dimensional parameter coverage and a quantitative limiting law give the statistic mathematical use independent of further conjectures.
